map.SAS（焦虑自评量表，Zung 1971）含 20 个条目，请按「过去一周」的实: The SAS (Self-Rating Anxiety Scale, Zung 1971) has 20 items. Please answer based on your actual feelings over the "past week". The result is for self-understanding and reference only and is not a medical diagnosis.
map.每题按症状出现的频度评 1~4 分：1=没有或很少时间，2=小部分时间，3=相当: Rate each item 1-4 by how often the symptom appears: 1 = never or rarely, 2 = a small part of the time, 3 = a considerable part of the time, 4 = most or all of the time. Items 5, 9, 13, 17 and 19 are
map.（选 1 记 4 分、选 2 记 3 分、选 3 记 2 分、选 4 记 1 分: (choosing 1 records 4 points, 2 records 3, 3 records 2, 4 records 1). Adding the 20 items gives a raw score of 20-80, and the standard score = raw score × 1.25 (rounded to an integer). Chinese norm reference: below 50 normal, 50-59 mild anxiety, 60-69 moderate anxiety, 70 or above severe anxiety.
map.点选项文字即可作答，也可用键盘 1–4 / ← →: Click the option text to answer; you can also use keys 1-4 / ← →
map.题号速览（点任意题号可回去改答案）: Question number overview (click any number to go back and change that answer)
map.SAS 评估的是「过去一周」你的实际感受，不是某一天或一辈子的状态: SAS assesses your actual feelings over the "past week", not a single day or your whole life
map.20 题中第 5、9、13、17、19 题为反向计分题（陈述的是「无焦虑」状态）: Items 5, 9, 13, 17 and 19 of the 20 are reverse-scored items (they are worded as a "no anxiety" state); the system flips them for you, so answer with your genuine feeling
map.每题 4 档从「很少」到「总在」，拿不准就选最接近的一档: Each question has 4 levels from "rarely" to "almost always"; if unsure, pick the closest one
map.答题进度仅保存在本机浏览器，点「重新测试」即可清空，数据不会上传: Your progress is stored only in this local browser. Click "Restart test" to clear it; no data is uploaded
map.焦虑倾向自查：经常莫名心慌、出汗、坐立不安时，用它判断焦虑水平是否达到需要关注的: Anxiety tendency self-check: when you often feel inexplicably nervous, sweaty or restless, use it to judge whether your anxiety level has reached a range worth watching.
map.配合 PHQ-9：焦虑和抑郁常同时出现，两个量表一起测能更全面地反映近期情绪状态: Use it together with PHQ-9: anxiety and depression often appear together, and measuring both scales together reflects your recent mood state more completely.
map.用药 / 咨询前后对照：干预一段时间后再测一次标准分，看是否下降。: Before and after medication or counseling: retest the standard score after a period of intervention and see whether it has dropped.
map.标准分是怎么算出来的: How the standard score is computed
map.20 道题的原始粗分范围是 20~80，乘以 1.25 并四舍五入得到 25~1: The 20 items give a raw score of 20-80, which multiplied by 1.25 and rounded yields a standard score of 25-100. Items 5, 9, 13, 17 and 19 are reverse items (the more "never" you experience the symptom, the higher the score recorded), which prevents habitual denial.
map.标准分超过 50 就是焦虑症吗？: Does a standard score above 50 mean I have an anxiety disorder?
map.不是诊断。中国常模以 50 为界，50~59 轻度、60~69 中度、≥70 重: It is not a diagnosis. Chinese norms use 50 as the cutoff: 50-59 mild, 60-69 moderate, 70 or above severe. It only flags that the anxiety level is high; whether it amounts to a disorder has to be judged by a physician.
map.为什么我「很少有症状」却分数不低？: Why is my score not low even though I "rarely have symptoms"?
map.大概率是反向题被反向计分了——这是量表设计，越是「从不」紧张的人，反向题反而记高: Most likely the reverse items were reverse-scored — this is how the scale is designed: people who are "never" nervous score high on reverse items, which is normal arithmetic.
